title: Paper-towel seed germination test
summary: Estimate viability with a labelled small sample before using scarce space.
steps: Count a known number of seeds, commonly 10 or more, and record the lot.
Place them in a moist, not dripping, clean paper towel inside a loose container or bag.
Keep at the crop-appropriate temperature and check daily for mould and sprouting.
Count normally germinated seeds at the expected interval and calculate the percentage.
Use a higher sowing rate for moderately reduced viability; replace lots with very poor or mouldy performance.
